appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Hydroelectricity vs Nuclear energy'.
x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2000 to 2050.
Blue solid line with circular markers represents Hydroelectricity. Data points labeled: 2010 (35%), 2020 (approx. 40%), 2030 (approx. 45%), 2040 (approx. 48%), 2050 (approx. 50%).
Red dashed line with square markers represents Nuclear energy. Data points labeled: 2010 (approx. 30%), 2020 (approx. 25%), 2030 (approx. 28%), 2040 (approx. 32%), 2050 (approx. 35%).
At the 2010 mark on the x-axis, the blue line (Hydroelectricity) is at 35%.
At the 2010 mark on the x-axis, the red line (Nuclear energy) is at approximately 30%.
